system.longDesc:
Also known as an LVA suit, this is a combination of a vac suit and light combat armor. It is a rubberized body suit equipped with a few strategically positioned Kevlar and ceramic plates. Its HUD can identify and track hostile targets while recognizing friendly ones. An LVA suit also provides mobility in the form of compressed-nitrogen-fueled thrusters. It can hold an air bottle that contains a 30-minute supply.

Armor bonus +4, armor penalty -3, Income TN 17.
